Location: Burnaby, BC (Hybrid with 1-2 days per week in office) Term Length: 4-8 Months Company Profile Optigo Networks is shaping the future of the commercial smart buildings industry by helping building owners and their service providers reduce the cost and complexity of deploying and managing operational technology (OT) networks. Our flagship product is Optigo Visual Networks, a SaaS solution for delivering best-in-class troubleshooting, monitoring, and solutioning of BACnet-based OT networks. We are a small, high-impact team where co-op students work on real features, real data, and real customer problems. Our valued customers include the world's largest multinational service providers, Fortune 500 companies, and educational institutions. The Role We are looking for a motivated Software Engineering Co-op to join our team. This role is ideal for a student who is passionate about code quality, automation, and leveraging modern AI coding tools to accelerate the full-cycle software development process. You will initially focus on strengthening our software foundation by creating and updating unit tests. Following this, you will collaborate with our DevOps team to integrate these tests into our automated CI/CD pipeline. As you gain familiarity with our systems, you will transition into full-stack development, contributing directly to the design and implementation of new features while utilizing AI-assisted workflows to maximize efficiency. Key Duties and Responsibilities • Unit Testing Excellence: Lead the initiative to create and update software unit tests across our codebase. You will be encouraged to use AI coding assistants (like Codex or Claude Code) to help generate comprehensive test cases, identify complex edge cases, and ensure high reliability. • DevOps & Automation: Partner with the DevOps team to automate unit test execution, ensuring they run seamlessly on every commit and Pull Request (PR) to maintain a healthy and fast development cycle. • Core Software Development: Progress into core development tasks, including designing and implementing software modules using TypeScript and Go for our cloud-based platforms. • System Design: Participate in design reviews and contribute to the architectural evolution of the Optigo Visual Networks platform. • Full Ownership: Take ownership of assigned modules, from initial design through implementation and validation. Mentorship: Work closely with senior engineers who are experts in IP networking, analytics, and SaaS architecture. • Why Join Optigo? • Direct Impact: Your work will ship to production and directly ensure the reliability of our products used by Fortune 500 companies. • AI-Forward Culture: We embrace the use of AI tools to help our engineers work smarter, scale test coverage rapidly, and focus their energy on high-level architecture and innovation. • Growth Culture: A culture that values clarity, curiosity, and continuous improvement. • Mentorship: Access to engineers who love teaching and solving hard problems. • Innovative Tech: Exposure to the emerging and exciting field of OT (Operational Technology) networking and smart building analytics. Learn more at www.optigo.net. Job Requirements Requirements • Currently enrolled in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related program. • Previous project or co-op experience in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Go. • Experience with Linux and AWS as a primary development environment. • AI Literacy: Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, or similar LLMs) to enhance coding productivity, refactor code, and accelerate problem-solving. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a curiosity to dig into complex systems. Proven ability to work in a collaborative team environment with clear communication. • Key Competencies • Solid academic performance and strong organizational skills. • Knowledge of data analysis with high-performance databases. • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and version control (Git). Ability to adapt to changing workflows and priorities in a fast-paced startup environment. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
